text.en:
Vehicle Shipping — UK to Turkey | Hanbros UK — Leader in UK–Turkey Logistics

Export your car, van or motorcycle from the United Kingdom to Turkey with Hanbros UK — the specialist in UK–Turkey vehicle logistics, handling DVLA export, shipping and Turkish registration support.

Vehicle shipping requires precise documentation: V5C logbook, proof of ownership, export declaration and Turkish import duty calculation. Our team has moved thousands of vehicles — from family saloons to classic cars — using enclosed trailers, Ro-Ro ferries and secure port handling.

Our Vehicle Shipping Services Include

  • Cars & vans: Road or sea transport with full insurance.
  • Motorcycles: Crated or palletised shipping options.
  • DVLA export: Notification and documentation support.
  • Customs brokerage: UK export and Turkish import clearance.
  • Delivery: Port collection or door-to-door to your Turkish address.

Why choose Hanbros UK? We are not a generic freight forwarder — we are built exclusively for the United Kingdom to Turkey corridor, with bilingual staff, transparent pricing and thousands of satisfied customers.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to ship a car from the UK to Turkey?

Depends on vehicle size, route and service level. Contact us with make, model and destination for a detailed quote including estimated Turkish import duty.

How long does vehicle shipping take?

Typically 2–4 weeks including export, transit and customs clearance.

Can you help with Turkish registration?

We coordinate delivery and provide guidance on local registration steps; partner agents can assist with TR plate procedures.

Hanbros UK — England origin. Turkey delivered. Request your free quote today on hanbroscargo.co.uk.
